result.brief: 提出基于 SDXL、LoRA、ControlNet 与 IP-Adapter 的多帧故事图像角色一致性流水线，并用 Best-of-K 重排与身份记忆减少身份漂移。
result.reason: Pipeline engineering for character-consistent story image generation using LoRA, ControlNet, IP-Adapter and reranking; no contribution to video/world models, representation learning, or unified understanding-generation.
